fields.title: Design expectations
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature: summarize 40 product reviews. Input 6,000 tokens, output 200, TTFT 1.4 s, speed 80 tokens/s.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1.4 + 200/80 = 3.9 s. UI: streaming; pause text 'reading 40 reviews'; output starts with the bottom line, no preamble; stop button. Speed up: summarization doesn't depend on the user — compute in advance and cache, updating when new reviews accumulate. Then user wait time is zero. Technique: ask if calculation at request time is mandatory.
